audit.independent_solution: OD is the perpendicular bisector of chord AB, so EA=EB. Since ∠BOC=90°, ∠BAC=45°. Therefore triangle AEB has equal 45° base angles, so BE⊥AC. Hence AE²+CE²=BE²+CE²=BC²=OB²+OC²=2 (B).
